events.summary: The Warriors led 16-8 with about 20 minutes left, but late tries from Herbie Farnworth and Jack Bostock gave the Dolphins a 26-16 win in front of a sold-out crowd.
With finals already out of reach, the Warriors women ended their NRLW season with a heavy loss in Brisbane.

events.summary: Leka Halasima scored twice, but the Knights won 12-10 in front of more than 48,000 at Eden Park, a record for rugby league in NZ, ending the Warriors' season in straight sets.

news.title: Ponga breaks arm in World Cup opener
news.summary: Kalyn Ponga fractured the radius in his left arm against Australia and was booked for surgery. He stays in camp, and Keano Kini is likely to start at fullback against the Cook Islands.

news.title: Brave Ponga racing the clock; McLean shoulder not serious
news.summary: Teammates hope Ponga could be back by the 15 November final. Coach Stacey Jones says Casey McLean's shoulder injury is not serious.

news.title: Kangaroos edge Kiwis 24-22 in World Cup opener
news.summary: Jack Bostock's debut hat-trick and a late winning try gave Australia victory in Sydney in front of a record 41,255 crowd.

news.title: Ponga and Gagai among new faces in Kiwis World Cup squad
news.summary: Stacey Jones named 23 players, captained by James Fisher-Harris. The six Warriors are Fisher-Harris, Erin Clark, Jacob Laban, Te Maire Martin, Charnze Nicoll-Klokstad and Tanner Stowers-Smith.

news.title: Olympic sevens duo bolster Kiwi Ferns World Cup squad
news.summary: Ricky Henry named 23 players, with seven potential debutants including Olympic gold medallists Stacey Waaka and Tenika Willison. Raecene McGregor and Georgia Hale are co-captains.

news.title: Five Warriors women in Kiwi Ferns squad
news.summary: Kaiyah Atai, Mele Hufanga, Ivana Lauitiiti, Apii Nicholls and Stacey Waaka of the Warriors NRLW side are in the Kiwi Ferns World Cup squad.

news.title: Rocco Berry re-signs with Warriors for 2027
news.summary: The centre missed the 2026 NRL season through injury and has signed a one-year deal. He has played 52 games and scored 13 tries for the club.

news.title: Webster named NRL Coach of the Year
news.summary: Andrew Webster won Coach of the Year at the Dally M awards after guiding the Warriors to second on the ladder. Finals were not counted in the voting.

news.title: Knights end Warriors' season at a record-crowd Eden Park
news.summary: The Warriors lost 12-10 to Newcastle in front of more than 48,000, after a 26-16 qualifying-final loss to the Dolphins. That ended a season in which they finished second on the ladder.

news.title: Kiwi Ferns open World Cup against Fiji today
news.summary: The Kiwi Ferns begin their Group B campaign against Fiji Bulikula at McDonald Jones Stadium, Newcastle, at 3:50pm NZT, live on Sky Sport Now.

news.title: Christchurch World Cup double-header nearing sell-out
news.summary: Kiwi Ferns v France and Kiwis v Cook Islands at One NZ Stadium on 25 October were close to selling out.
